name: Bamboo clump (our own design)
about: Made by tools/battle-models/asia (scenery). Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at its foot. Stands still: `sway` (0 to 1, point by point) is how far the wind moves each point; nothing else moves. Looks only: the battle's ground decides cover and passage. Paints: 0 bamboo, 1 bamboo_old, 2 leaf, 3 leaf_dark, 4 leaf_light, 5 leaf_dry, 6 earth, 7 leaf_shade
